sources.title: IIT Roorkee statement denying association with unauthorised internship/training providers

summary: IIT Roorkee issued a statement saying it has no collaboration with this organisation and does not authorise it to offer internships or training on the institute's behalf.

sources.title: AICTE circular warning against imposters and lookalike domains

summary: AICTE stated that people falsely claiming to be AICTE officials were approaching people about fake recruitment, and separately confirmed that these lookalike domains are not affiliated with the council.
